description: This file provides pybind11 bindings for converting between Eigen matrices (dense and sparse) and Python objects, including numpy arrays and scipy sparse matrices. It includes type casters, utility functions, and template specializations for Eigen types.

classes.name: EigenConformable
classes.description: Template struct capturing numpy/Eigen array conformance and stride information for Eigen matrices.

methods.name: eigen_array_cast
methods.description: Casts Eigen matrices to numpy arrays, optionally referencing existing data.

methods.name: eigen_ref_array
methods.description: Creates a numpy array referencing an Eigen object, with optional parent for lifetime management.

methods.name: eigen_encapsulate
methods.description: Encapsulates a pointer to an Eigen object into a numpy array with a capsule for lifetime management.
